name: OTP Verification for WooCommerce
author: Nouman Ijaz

sections.description:
OTP Verification for WooCommerce adds an email OTP verification system to WooCommerce user registration.

The plugin intercepts registration submissions and verifies the user’s email address before account creation is completed.

Features

  • OTP email verification popup
  • WooCommerce registration integration
  • SMTP compatible
  • Lightweight and optimized
  • Failed attempt protection
  • Easy enable/disable settings
  • Compatible with popular SMTP plugins
  • HPOS compatible

For reliable email delivery, using an SMTP plugin such as WP Mail SMTP is recommended.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/otp-verification-for-woocommerce directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Configure SMTP if required.
  4. Navigate to Settings → OTP Verify.
  5. Enable OTP verification.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and activated.

Does it support SMTP plugins?

Yes. The plugin works with most WordPress SMTP plugins.

Is the plugin lightweight?

Yes. The plugin is optimized for minimal performance impact.
